subject: ophthalmology
title: Corneal Graft Rejection and Keratoplasty

steps.tx: **Corneal graft rejection** is immune attack on donor endothelium or stroma after keratoplasty, giving graft oedema, keratic precipitates on donor, rejection line and vision fall in previously clear graft. Vascularised host beds and prior rejection raise risk because immune privilege weakens. Early steroid rescue reverses endothelial rejection if endothelium survives, delay costing permanent failure.
steps.say: Immune attack together gives graft clouding after clear interval in keratoplasty follow up at specialist clinics over months. Early rescue gives endothelial salvage window. Vascular bed gives risk prediction.

steps.tx: **Khodadoust line** is linear endothelial rejection front of precipitates advancing across donor endothelium, pathognomonic rejection sign at slit lamp. Epithelial rejection lines and stromal infiltrates give other layer rejections usually self limited or steroid responsive. Endothelial form threatens permanence because human endothelium barely regenerates after immune killing.
steps.say: Linear precipitate front together gives endothelial rejection recognition at slit lamp during graft follow up in clinic characteristically. Layer forms give severity separation additionally. Endothelial loss gives permanence risk.

steps.tx: Penetrating keratoplasty replaces full thickness cornea for deep scars, while lamellar techniques replace diseased layers selectively: anterior lamellar for stromal scar sparing healthy endothelium, endothelial keratoplasty for endothelial failure sparing healthy stroma. **Layer surgery** principle reduces rejection and structural risks by replacing only failed layer where possible.
steps.say: Layer selective replacement together gives modern keratoplasty principle in corneal surgery at referral centres for scar and failure. Endothelium sparing gives rejection reduction benefit. Full replacement gives deep scar role.

steps.tx: **Endothelial keratoplasty** strips diseased host endothelium and inserts donor endothelial lenticule through small incision for Fuchs or pseudophakic failure, faster rehabilitation and less astigmatism than penetrating surgery. Graft detachment managed by air rebubbling is its early signature complication. Stromal clarity returns as pump function resumes over weeks.
steps.say: Endothelial lenticule insertion together gives pump restoration in endothelial failure at modern corneal units with small incisions. Detachment gives rebubbling management early. Rehabilitation gives speed advantage additionally.

steps.tx: High risk graft beds vascularised in quadrants, inflamed, previously rejected or paediatric need systemic or intensified immunosuppression and counselling on guarded prognosis. Quiet vascular free scar grafts carry best survival statistics quoted to routine patients. **Bed grading** therefore precedes donor allocation ethics and consent in keratoplasty lists.
steps.say: Bed vascularisation together gives survival grading before keratoplasty listing at corneal services for scar patients in clinic. High risk gives intensified suppression need. Counselling gives guarded prognosis honesty.

steps.tx: Suture complications, astigmatism management and rejection surveillance structure graft follow up years, selective suture removal guided by topography shaping focus progressively. Patient education on rejection redness, pain and vision fall symptoms with same day access saves grafts more than routine intervals alone. **Red eye in graft** is rejection until examined, discharge instruction phrase.
steps.say: Red eye together gives rejection urgency in graft patients at any follow up interval after keratoplasty in discharge teaching always. Topography gives suture shaping additionally. Same day access gives salvage value.

steps.tx: Failure versus rejection distinction: failed graft never cleared or clouds from endothelial attrition without inflammatory line, rejection clouds previously clear graft with immune signs. Treatment differs, rescue steroids for rejection, regraft planning for attrition failure. **Clear interval** history therefore decides rescue attempt legitimacy at presentation.
steps.say: Clear interval together gives rejection separation from attrition failure during graft assessment in clinic at presentation urgently. Rescue gives inflammatory pathway direction. Regraft gives attrition endpoint.

steps.tx: Anchors: line rejects endothelium, layers select surgery, beds grade survival and red eye rescues same day. Lamellar sparing reduces rejection, endothelial barely regenerates and quiet beds survive longest. **Khodadoust** name answers endothelial rejection in one word. Donor tissue allocation follows the same bed grading in waiting list priority discussions.
steps.say: Rejection line together gives endothelial recognition while bed grading gives survival prediction at graft clinics for patients reliably. Layer selection gives modern surgery principle additionally. Same day review gives salvage rule.

Replace only failed layer: anterior for stromal scar, endothelial for pump failure.
Rejection clouds clear graft with immune line; attrition clouds slowly without inflammation.
